text: Lost a 3+0 blitz game where I held a balanced endgame for 40 moves, then blundered a piece in time pressure on move 52.
Drew a position I was up two pawns in by repetition — couldn't find a way through the opposite-coloured-bishop ending.
Built a kingside attack with all pieces aimed at the king, then missed the defensive resource and got mated in 4.
Traded queens into a knight endgame I thought was holding. It was lost; I resigned on move 38.
Mis-remembered my King's Indian repertoire move 9, gave up the d5 break, slow positional loss over 50 moves.
Up a pawn in a rook endgame, walked into a back-rank mate I should have seen three moves out.
Had a clearly winning position with 2 seconds left to make 10 moves. Flagged. Opponent had 30 seconds.
Missed a forced 4-move combination that would have won material. Engine showed +4.5; played a quiet move that lost the thread.
Traded down from a complex position I should have kept tense. Resulting endgame was dead-drawn; agreed draw move 60.
Lost round 1 of a tournament to a lower-rated player and never recovered psychologically — went 0/4 the rest of the day.
